overview:
Content Endorsed Course

This course provides students with the opportunity to develop an understanding of ceramic processes and practices, and the ways in which these can be used in making a range of products and artworks. Students develop understandings of the histories, conventions, traditions and contemporary applications of ceramics to inform their own practice. 

Read the full Ceramics Stage 6 course description.

Related industries

The knowledge and skills developed in this course can be applied across a range of career pathways. 

Industries related to this course include, but are not limited to, the following outlined on the Your Career website: 

  • Arts and Recreation Services
  • Information Media and Telecommunications
  • Manufacturing
  • Professional, Scientific and Technical Services
